picks.rationale: The first full review of Google's flagship: the Pixel 11 folds AI straight into social posting and capture, so it shows where on-device AI is landing in everyday product UX rather than in spec sheets.
picks.excerpt: The Pixel 11 gets social with some interesting new tools — a full review of how Google blends social media features and AI magic into its new flagship.

picks.rationale: Google quietly drew the hardware line for on-device AI: Gemini Intelligence needs Nano 3, and the first Nano 4 phones are already listed — the clearest signal yet of which devices will actually run next-gen local models.
picks.excerpt: Following the launch of the Pixel 11 series, Google updated its developer documentation for Gemini Nano 4 — spelling out that Gemini Intelligence requires Nano 3 and naming the first Nano 4 devices.

picks.rationale: Apple's long-delayed assistant rebuild finally ships as a standalone app in iOS 27, and this is the hands-on walkthrough of what it can actually do — the most immediately usable item in the pool.
picks.excerpt: A practical walkthrough of the new standalone Siri app in iOS 27 — what it handles, how it differs from the old assistant, and where the rebuilt experience still falls short.

picks.rationale: A $550 robot vacuum with automatic mop removal and a self-cleaning dock is the concrete version of 'ambient AI' — the interaction design goal here is that the product disappears from the user's attention entirely.
picks.excerpt: Roborock's new Qrevo 2 Pro packs 25,000Pa suction, automatic mop removal, anti-tangle brushes, and a smarter self-cleaning dock for $550 — engineered so you forget it is there.

picks.rationale: A two-stage pipeline that lifts UHD low-light images without smearing texture or edges targets the exact failure mode of current night modes — research that maps directly onto how phone cameras will render detail next.
picks.excerpt: Researchers have developed a two-stage AI system that enhances ultra-high-definition low-light images while preserving fine textures, edges and scene details — the part night mode usually destroys.
